title: [WIP][NOT FOR GA] Route experiments: statistical significance exploration (p-values + guardrail-safe display)
author: Mei Lin
body:
Context: We’ve had multiple internal asks for “is this difference real?” on the Route Experiments results page. GA scope explicitly excluded a full stat-sig engine, but this PR explores a minimal/guardrail-safe approach we could optionally add post-GA. This PR is a draft/WIP and is NOT intended to ship or be enabled by default.

What this adds (exploration only): (1) A small `stats_sig` module that computes simple two-sided p-values + confidence intervals from existing rollups, (2) a results API experiment that returns significance metadata alongside existing deltas, and (3) a Console dev-only flag that renders the values with heavy disclaimers.

Approach (intentionally simple, likely wrong in edge cases): - Latency + cost/token: Welch’s t-test over hourly rollup “means” (treating each hour as an independent sample; uses variance derived from sum/sum_sq where available, otherwise approximates variance and marks result as low-confidence). - Error rate: two-proportion z-test using request counts and error counts. - Throughput: treated like latency/cost (Welch on hourly means).

Important caveats / why this is WIP: - Independence assumptions are violated (temporal correlation, shared infrastructure events). - Mixed-model workloads and region/model shifts can confound comparisons; no stratification. - Multiple comparisons not addressed (route x metric x variant). - Rollup-derived variance is often incomplete for older windows; we currently backfill some but not all (this PR does not change retention/backfill behavior). - Small splits (e.g., 1–5%) produce unstable hourly samples; this PR gates significance output behind minimum sample thresholds and returns `status=INSUFFICIENT_DATA` otherwise.

Guardrail safety: This does NOT drive auto-stop. This only affects the results payload under an explicit opt-in query param (`include_significance=true`) and is additionally gated server-side by `route_experiments_significance_exploration` feature flag. Console UI is behind `consoleRouteExperimentsSignificanceExploration` and includes a persistent “EXPERIMENTAL” banner.

API shape (proposed): Results endpoint adds `significance_notes` and a flat set of fields per metric (e.g. `latency_p95_p_value`, `latency_p95_ci_low`, `latency_p95_ci_high`, `latency_p95_status`). Kept intentionally flat to avoid adding nested JSON in response logs and to reduce payload churn.

Testing: Unit tests cover the math helpers, sample-size gating, and “do not crash on missing variance” behavior. Added a couple of golden tests for deterministic outputs.

Rollout: None. This PR includes a `DO_NOT_MERGE` label suggestion and a failing CI marker until we decide whether to proceed.

Follow-ups if we keep this direction: add stratification by {region, model_id} (or at least weighted aggregation), clarify time-bucketing vs request-level sampling, add multiple-comparison corrections, and/or move to a Bayesian approach for rate metrics. Also need explicit Product copy for what we do/don’t promise.

References: - Slack: post-GA followups thread (stat-sig + custom metrics). - PM-482: GA requirements (explicitly excluded full stat-sig).
commits: b3f0c2c analytics: add stats_sig helpers (welch t-test, z-test) with guardrails
a7d91d4 results-api: add include_significance flag + flat significance fields
2f8e6aa console: dev-only rendering of p-values with experimental banner
c9a4d10 tests: golden tests for significance outputs and insufficient-data gating
d11f5ae chore: feature flag plumbing + docs comments (NOT FOR GA)
ci_checks: unit tests (console-api) — FAIL (1): results_types snapshot mismatch
review_thread: Logan Wright (Telemetry) — Comment: We should be very explicit that the underlying rollups are hourly aggregates and not request-level samples. Treating hours as independent samples is going to be misleading during incidents/traffic shifts. Can we make the output say `method=HOURLY_WELCH_T` and include sample_count=hours_used?
Mei Lin — Reply: Yep. I’ll add `*_method` + `*_n_samples` and include an always-on disclaimer string in the payload. Also adding `status=LOW_CONFIDENCE` when variance is approximated.

Nadia Rahman (Cost attribution) — Comment: For cost/token, are we using mean(cost_per_token) or sum(cost)/sum(tokens)? The latter is what customers intuitively expect; the former will overweight small requests.

Mei Lin — Reply: Great catch. I switched to ratio-of-sums for the delta already, but the stat test path was using hourly means. I’ll align the test input to hourly ratio-of-sums and compute variance via delta-method approximation when possible; otherwise return LOW_CONFIDENCE.

Marissa Cole (Product) — Comment: Please keep this 100% out of GA and avoid UI screenshots in release notes. If anything lands, it should be a dev-only toggle with language like “experimental / directional only”. Also, no “significant / not significant” wording.
Mei Lin — Reply: Agreed. I’ll change copy to “signal strength” and only show numeric p-values/CI with “experimental” banner; no binary callouts.

Dylan Brooks (Console Eng) — Comment: The results payload is already large. Adding dozens of fields per metric risks perf and query costs. Can we gate on a narrower set first (e.g. only error_rate and cost/token) and add caching headers?

Mei Lin — Reply: I can scope the first cut to error_rate + cost/token and keep latency off until we have better variance. For now, the endpoint only computes significance if `include_significance=true`, and it uses existing cached rollups (no new heavy query).

Sean Gallagher (SRE) — Comment: Please ensure none of this can accidentally affect guardrail evaluation or auto-stop. Also, the wording “confidence interval” can imply correctness. Suggest “approx interval” and ensure flags default off everywhere.

Mei Lin — Reply: Confirmed: this code path is only in results read API and cannot influence guardrails/auto-stop. I’ll update naming to `approx_ci_*` and ensure server-side flag is hard-default false.
merge_outcome: Not merged. Draft PR kept open for discussion; do not ship as part of Route Experiments GA.
notes: Explicitly not in GA scope; do not backport.
Requires feature flag `route_experiments_significance_exploration` to be enabled to return significance fields.
Console UI is hidden behind `consoleRouteExperimentsSignificanceExploration` and should remain disabled outside dev/staging.
